categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in precision functional parts, structural parts, modules, and chargers, serving AI terminal devices, communications, automotive, and photovoltaic energy storage industries. It has expanded from consumer electronics manufacturing to an AI terminal hardware manufacturing platform, providing R&D, design, production, sales, and solutions for core upstream components in the AI terminal hardware supply chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include advanced manufacturing processes such as precision stamping, CNC machining, injection molding, metal injection molding (MIM), ceramic injection molding (CIM), and carbon fiber hybrid molding. The company employs intelligent AOI inspection systems, automated production lines, and integrates lean, automated, digital, and intelligent manufacturing principles. It also develops ultra-thin stainless steel vapor chambers, heat dissipation solutions, and high-precision assembly techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global leading consumer electronics brands and their upstream suppliers, focusing on AI terminal devices like smartphones, laptops, tablets, smart wearables, XR devices, as well as communications equipment, new energy vehicles, and photovoltaic energy storage markets. Its customers include top-tier international clients in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover domestic China and international markets, with overseas production bases in regions including Finland, India, Singapore, Vietnam, Brazil, Turkey, and the United States. The company maintains a global supply chain and customer base, emphasizing international market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, manufacturing precision functional and structural components, modules, and chargers. It integrates upstream raw materials and downstream assembly and ODM services, positioning itself as a one-stop intelligent manufacturing platform for AI terminal hardware.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AI terminal hardware manufacturing capabilities, advancing lean, automated, digital, and intelligent production ('one core, four modernizations'), and pursuing green, low-carbon sustainable development. R&D focuses on materials, processes, and manufacturing technologies, with a systematic three-tier R&D platform (research institute, engineering college, BG/BU centers). The company emphasizes innovation in heat dissipation, carbon fiber structures, and AI hardware integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct product sales of precision components, modules, chargers, and related assembly services. The company also provides ODM and JDM services, with sales primarily conducted via direct sales channels to major customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in precision manufacturing for AI terminal hardware, holding a leading market share in precision functional parts and structural components. It competes with other advanced manufacturers in consumer electronics and emerging sectors like new energy vehicles and photovoltaic storage, leveraging its comprehensive manufacturing capabilities and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 34.12 billion with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.05 billion, representing a 28.5% year-over-year profit growth. The company maintains strong cash flow and has steadily increased its automotive and photovoltaic business segments. It has a large workforce with nearly 79,000 employees and invests heavily in R&D with over 5,900 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, high-quality manufacturing with advanced technologies and integrated intelligent production systems. It offers a one-stop AI terminal hardware manufacturing platform with strong R&D capabilities, enabling customized, innovative solutions for complex AI terminal devices. Its focus on green manufacturing, automation, and close collaboration with leading global customers differentiates it in the market.
